description: Figure 5 is a grouped bar chart that compares the performance gain, measured in percentage points, of three different LLM architectures—GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL—when using predictive rollout search. The chart displays two types of supervision: "Strong Supervision," represented by a blue bar with a diagonal striped pattern, and "Weak Supervision," represented by a solid blue bar. The x-axis lists the three model architectures, while the y-axis, labeled "Performance Gain (+%)" and scaled from 0 to 30, quantifies the improvement. For all three models, the performance gain under strong supervision is significantly higher than under weak supervision. Specifically, for GPT-4o, the gain is approximately 25% under strong supervision and about 5% under weak supervision. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the gains are roughly 10% and 4%, respectively. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the gains are approximately 15% and 5%. The legend at the top of the chart clearly distinguishes the two supervision types.
